architecture:
System: Records-Service-154
Primary NIST family: Risk Assessment (RA); evidence focus: RA-7.
Environment: GCP. Network access uses Private Service Connect; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Cloud KMS key. Control evidence: authenticated vulnerability scanning and monitoring run continuously with tracked remediation. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
